proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG DEBT REPAYMENT SCHEDULE AS OF JUNE 30 2011`, PDF pages 76 and 77 of the FY2011 annual town report (4117-fy-2011-annual-town-report.pdf), printed folios 73 and 74. BOTH PAGES ARE PHOTOGRAPHS printed 180 degrees from upright -- pdfplumber returns 0 words on every page of this report. WHY THIS PAGE WAS `refused` AND WHY THAT SAID NOTHING ABOUT THE DOCUMENT: the whole schedule is printed in WHOLE DOLLARS, so the archive's money pattern `[\d,]+\.\d\d` matches 1 of about 300 digit-bearing boxes on p76 and 1 of 79 on p77. A figure the pattern misses is not an absent figure (rule 13c). THE ISSUE IS IDENTIFIED BY ITS PRINTED POSITION, NOT BY ITS NAME. The page prints FOURTEEN issue blocks and only nine distinct names: `MUNICIPAL PURPOSE` appears FIVE times (positions 4, 6, 8, 10 and 14) and `PRINCIPAL`/`INTEREST` repeat under every one of them. Keying on the name collapses five issues into one and overwrites their cells. The position is counted off the page top-down and is asserted unique in the generator. THE TABLE IS RULED -- every cell is boxed -- so unlike the trust matrix on pp.73-74 there is no label-to-figure pairing problem here: a figure is in the year column whose box it sits in. Each issue prints three rows, `PRINCIPAL`, `INTEREST` and a TOTAL row named for the instrument (`TOTAL MASS WATER POLL TRUST` -- the page's own spelling, with POLL for POOL -- or `TOTAL MUNICIPAL PURPOSE`). Years run FY2012-FY2030 on page 76 and FY2031-FY2047 plus a `TOTAL` column on page 77. THIS GROUP is the issue printed at POSITION 2, `MASS WATER POOL 4*`. WHAT PROVES IT: every year closes on the page's own identity principal + interest = total, and the three year-columns sum to the three figures the `TOTAL` column of page 77 prints for this issue.
